correctness.rationale: Re-derived maximal subgroups of D2n: R and M_{p,i}, intersection Phi=<r^rad(n)>. In the Frattini-core maximal-subgroup nerve a face either omits a prime block or is a unique Chinese-remainder transversal without R. The base is invariant cone R*L, whose equivariant collapse leaves rad(n) (omega(n)-1)-spheres indexed by residues and permuted affinely with orientations fixed by prime-block vertex order. For omega=1 the discrete wedge has rad(n)+1 points. Character equals fixed residue count gcd(a-1,m) when it divides b, and 0 otherwise. Independently checked the affine trace congruence for all automorphisms at n=6,12,30. Finite tests are supplementary to universal subgroup/nerve proof.
